source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 decembrie — «Sfântul Nifon, Episcop de Constanțiana»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νήφων επίσκοπος Κωνσταντιανής»

attestations.note: The life page `/3308/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and the see is the same one the folder's name carries. What the page prints in place of a life is a note on the manuscripts: «Ο Όσιος Νήφων είναι άγνωστος στους Συναξαριστές και τα Μηναία», his life being in the ancient codices and later ones — the Lavriotic Β81 ff. 1-155, 123 ff. 228α-278, Λ. 66 ff. 32α-58, and the Vatopedi 618 ff. 143α-159 — under the title «Βίος καὶ πολιτεία τοῦ ὁσίου πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νήφωνος τοῦ ἐν Κωνσταντινουπόλει μὲν ἀσκήσαντος, γενομένου δὲ ἐπισκόπου Κωνσταντιανῆς κατὰ Ἀλεξάνδρειαν». **Two things in that note an author may want.** The title places his Constantia in Egypt, by Alexandria, and says he practised asceticism at Constantinople before the see; and the Lavriotic Codex Β 81 calls him instead **bishop of Almyroupolis** and says he died on 23 December. Neither is drafted as a name, an office or a date: they are recorded here and in the life. The page adds an akolouthia in the Cryptoferrata Codex Δ. δ. II and a free rendering of the life in the book «Ένας ασκητής Επίσκοπος», published by the monastery of the Paraclete at Oropos in 1993. No year of birth or death as such, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (28 September 2026).

hymns.text: Făcându-te cinstit lăcaş al dumnezeiescului har, Nifone, te-ai arătat păstor al Bisericii, de Dumnezeu chemat; chipuri de pocăinţă ai învăţat şi te-ai îmbogăţit cu darul nepătimirii, Părinte cuvioase, roagă-L pe Hristos Dumnezeu să ne dăruiască mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Nifon, Episcop de Constanțiana, glas 3

english.text: Having made yourself an honoured dwelling of the divine grace, Niphon, you were shown a shepherd of the Church, called by God; you taught the ways of repentance and were enriched with the gift of dispassion. Venerable father, pray to Christ God to grant us great mercy.
